content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I’m trying to use all three on/off times in my weekly timer setup, displaying and editing them through mapped memory words on a web page. This works as expected when accessed from a PC—each change is registered once I press the 'enter' key. However, on a mobile browser, the 'enter' key becomes a 'tab' key, so only the value in the last field updates. This is a frustrating issue. Does anyone have any suggestions? [url] shows how it works on PC, and I’ve attached images for mobile attempts.
Unfortunately, without the 'enter' key, it’s not possible. On the PC, pressing 'enter' submits the change, and you see 'submitted' briefly as confirmation.
Have you tried using a different mobile browser? The one shown seems very basic.

Yes, I’ve tried other browsers and different Android devices—all use Gboard, and browsers are Chrome or based on Chromium. Testing with other keyboard apps gives the same result. In other apps like Telegram, Viber, and notepads the 'enter' key appears as normal, but for this webpage it switches to 'tab.' If I connect an external USB keyboard with an actual 'enter' key, everything works fine, but that’s not a real solution. Has anyone else encountered this issue? How do you update weekly timer setpoints in your mobile setup?
Changing values in the extended web browser only works if you use the 'enter' key after editing. The 'tab' key does not trigger the change. That’s about all I can say.

I completely understand. But also, please understand it’s not my fault—I use the tools provided by [company_name] and [product_name]. I can’t change anything in them. The keyboard behavior on [product_name]-generated web pages is entirely defined by the scripts produced by [product_name]. Again, has no one else run into this before? How do you edit weekly timers from your mobile applications?
So, is the lack of an 'enter' key in the mobile keyboard actually an issue with [company_name]?
Do you have a [product_name] head module, version [version_no]? For a test, could you try configuring the weekly timers? Maybe your mobile device works correctly—if so, could you share a video?
I don’t see the point in responding further. If you think it’s a [company_name] issue, consider reaching out to their support directly.
I’m not asking you specifically to reply. Maybe someone else has insights—let’s hear their thoughts.
You’re right, I’m leaving this discussion.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face a major usability issue when trying to update weekly timer values on web pages generated by [product_name] on mobile devices. The mobile keyboard lacks an 'enter' key, which is necessary for submitting changes; instead, only a 'tab' key is shown, so only the last edit field is updated. This discrepancy between mobile and desktop browser experiences impacts the convenience and flexibility of configuration from mobile devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily edit and confirm weekly timer values through their mobile devices, with the same reliability and feedback found on desktop browsers.
pain_keywords: usability gap between PC and mobile
